messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It keeps stopping or it’s just really slow, and it’s getting on my nerves. I need to have excellent internet speed on my phone—nothing less will do. I’m in France right now and I don’t have access to Wi-Fi. Can you help me fix this, please?
I can help you with your mobile data issue. To get started, I need to verify your account. Could you please provide your phone number or your full name and date of birth?
My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. If you need my date of birth, please let me know.

Thank you for providing your information. You have multiple lines on your account. Could you please confirm which phone number (or line) is experiencing the mobile data issue? This will help me check the correct line and resolve your problem efficiently.
The phone number with the problem is 555-123-2002—the one I’m using right now. That’s the one where the mobile data keeps cutting out or is very slow.

{"line_id": "L1002", "phone_number": "555-123-2002", "status": "Active", "plan_id": "P1002", "device_id": "D1002", "data_used_gb": 8.7, "data_refueling_gb": 0.0, "roaming_enabled": true, "contract_end_date": "2026-12-31", "last_plan_change_date": "2024-12-15", "last_sim_replacement_date": "2025-01-20", "suspension_start_date": null}
{"plan_id": "P1002", "name": "Premium Plan", "data_limit_gb": 15.0, "price_per_month": 65.0, "data_refueling_price_per_gb": 2.0}

Thank you for confirming the phone number. I see your line is active, roaming is enabled, and you are on the Premium Plan with a 15GB data limit (you've used about 8.7GB so far).

To diagnose the issue further, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- What network signal strength you see (bars or icons)?
- If you see any icons like "5G", "4G", "3G", or "E"?
- If there are any icons indicating Airplane Mode or Data Saver is on?

This information will help me pinpoint the cause of your slow or interrupted mobile data.
(guides the customer through a device action)
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

Looking at my phone’s status bar, I see one bar for signal strength, and it says “2G.” Mobile data is enabled, and my battery is at 80%. I don’t see any icons for Airplane Mode or Data Saver. What should I do next?

Thank you for the details. Your phone is currently connected to a 2G network, which is much slower than 4G or 5G and is likely the reason for your slow or interrupted mobile data.

To improve your speed, please change your phone’s network mode preference to allow 4G or 5G connections. On your device, look for the option to set your network mode and select “4G/5G Preferred” (or a similar option).

Once you’ve done this, please check your status bar again and let me know if you see “4G” or “5G” and if your signal strength improves. This should help you get much faster mobile data in France.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I changed the network mode like you said, and now the status bar shows full bars for signal and says “5G.” Mobile data is still enabled. What should I do next to make sure I get excellent speed?

Great! Now that your phone is connected to a 5G network with full signal, let’s confirm your internet speed.

Please run a speed test on your device and let me know the result (download speed and quality rating, if available). This will help us verify that your mobile data is performing at an excellent level.
(guides the customer through a device action)
Speed test failed: No Connection.
I tried to run a speed test, but it says “No Connection.” Even though it shows 5G and full bars, it seems like the internet still isn’t working. What should I do now?

Thank you for letting me know. Since your phone shows 5G and full bars but you have no internet connection, the issue may be with your SIM card or your phone’s APN (network) settings.

Let’s start by checking your SIM card status. Please check your SIM card status on your device and let me know if it says “Active,” “Missing,” or “Locked.” This will help us determine the next step.
(guides the customer through a device action)
Your SIM card is active and working.
I checked, and it says my SIM card is active and working. What should I do next?

Thank you for confirming your SIM card is active. The next step is to check your phone’s APN settings, as incorrect APN settings can prevent mobile data from working even when you have a strong signal.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if anything looks incorrect or if the MMSC URL is missing. If you’re unsure, just let me know what you see for the APN name and MMSC URL.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Current APN Name: internet
MMSC URL (for picture messages): http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc
(These are technical settings, usually best left unchanged.)

I looked at my APN settings, and the APN name says “internet.” The MMSC URL shows “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” I’m not sure if this is right, but that’s what I see. Is that okay, or do I need to do something else?

Thank you for providing your APN details. The APN name and MMSC URL you shared look standard, but sometimes resetting the APN settings can resolve hidden configuration issues, especially when roaming internationally.

Please reset your APN settings to default on your device. After resetting, you must reboot your phone for the changes to take effect. 

Once you’ve done both steps (reset APN and reboot), try running a speed test again and let me know if your mobile data is working.
(guides the customer through a device action)

APN settings will reset at reboot.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve reset the APN settings as you asked. I’m a little worried about rebooting my phone—will I lose any of my photos or anything important when I do this?

You will not lose any of your photos, messages, or personal data by rebooting your phone. Rebooting simply restarts your device and applies the new network settings. It’s a safe step and is often necessary to resolve connectivity issues.

Please go ahead and reboot your phone now. After it restarts, try using your mobile data and running a speed test again. Let me know if your internet connection improves or if you still have issues.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Resetting APN settings...
Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
(guides the customer through a device action)
Speed test failed: No Connection.

I followed your instructions: I reset the APN and rebooted my phone, but when I try to run a speed test, it still says there’s no connection. My status bar still shows 5G and excellent signal. What now? This is getting really frustrating, and I need excellent internet speed.

Thank you for your patience and for following all the steps. Since your SIM is active, APN settings are correct, you have 5G signal, and you’ve rebooted, but you still have no data connection, this may be an issue with your line or account that cannot be resolved through device settings.

I will transfer you to a human agent who can investigate this further and provide advanced support.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
